# ATLAS Demolition & Site Work

> Demolition and concrete contractor in Columbia, Missouri, serving Mid-Missouri within about 45 minutes: Columbia, Jefferson City, Fulton, Moberly, Fayette, Boonville, Ashland and surrounding towns. Locally owned. Licensed and insured (general liability, umbrella, workers' compensation). Phone (573) 234-6641. Email chris@deployatlas.com.

What we do: structural demolition (houses, mobile homes, garages, barns, sheds, decks), commercial and interior/selective demolition, concrete removal (slabs, driveways, sidewalks, foundations, retaining walls), parking lot removal and replacement (asphalt or concrete), driveway replacement, and site work after a teardown (backfill, grading, pad prep, gravel). Pricing: fixed price for labor and equipment, disposal billed at actual tonnage. Free on-site consultation, written bid.

What we do not do: land clearing, forestry mulching, tree work, standalone excavation or trenching, septic, foundation repair, concrete leveling or mudjacking, patch repair.

## Services
- [Demolition services](https://deployatlas.com/demolition/): hub for all demolition work, pricing model, permits and disconnects, FAQ
- [House, garage and barn demolition](https://deployatlas.com/demolition/structural/): structural teardowns with basement backfill and final grade
- [Mobile home removal](https://deployatlas.com/demolition/mobile-home-removal/): single and double-wide removal, cost ranges, permits, paperwork
- [Interior and selective demolition](https://deployatlas.com/demolition/interior-selective/): commercial strip-outs, tenant finish demo, occupied buildings
- [Concrete and paving](https://deployatlas.com/concrete/): hub for concrete removal and replacement
- [Concrete removal](https://deployatlas.com/concrete/concrete-removal/): slabs, driveways, sidewalks, foundations; per-square-foot ranges
- [Parking lot removal and replacement](https://deployatlas.com/concrete/parking-lot-removal/): commercial lots, phasing, asphalt vs concrete, ranges
- [Driveway replacement](https://deployatlas.com/concrete/driveway-replacement/): tear out and pour back, base prep, cure times
- [Site work after demolition](https://deployatlas.com/site-work/): backfill, compaction, grading, pad prep, gravel drives and lots
- [Free consultation](https://deployatlas.com/consultation/): request a site visit and a written bid
